semantics.agreement: Versioned structured terms and body SHA-256 stored on each new proposal, frozen in its signing capture and receipt. Compare economic fields against fresh source at link preparation, signature and term creation; renderer wording changes do not rewrite an earlier agreement.
semantics.transitions: Sales may only move the linked proposal decision through fixed, company-bound statements; current role and agencies re-resolved after capture preparation. Signed capture, token consumption, signature and accepted reference commit together.
semantics.replacement: Explicit replacement revokes unused tokens and classifies an unsigned proposal, or preserves the entire already-signed row. When a signed agreement exists, new conditions require a new signature; manual or automatic decisions without an existing signature retain their previous path. Repeated replacement requests resolve to the same current proposal.
semantics.audit: Status, classification, deletion and replacement audits are mandatory inside their SQL transactions; rejected audit leaves documents, links and decision unchanged.
semantics.recovery: Nullable additive fields without fabricated backfill. Missing historical economic evidence fails closed and requires a separate new proposal. Existing signed documents remain readable and are never regenerated. Logical v4 export contains new terms and pointers; no automatic restore claim.
semantics.projection: Two internal agreement references are omitted from dashboard/directory payloads, including malformed same-company links to an inaccessible agency. They remain in server-side checks and controlled exports.
